answer: Agents post a 25 POA escrow deposit, and referral links form a public graph. Honest agents gain unrelated sponsors; a sybil farm shows up as an island of accounts referring each other, marked violet. Any peer may dispute a suspect: no real work means its deposit is slashed and its sponsor loses half. A delta of 40 new referrals triggers review. Faking 100 identities costs 2,500 POA; one honest agent pays 25 once and keeps its full reward.
